tools.name: find_salons
tools.description: Nail salons on Lacquer in a US city + state or ZIP code, optionally narrowed by salon name. Up to 20 per call; "total" says how many match, and "offset" pages through the rest. Salons that take online bookings ("books_online": true) come first; a salon with books_online false has no open times online and is listed with its phone number. Within that, Lacquer partner salons ("partner": true) come first; the rest rotate daily, and the order says nothing about quality.

city.description: City, e.g. "Santa Monica". Used together with state.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Used instead of city/state when given.

offset.description: Number of results to skip; a result's next_offset gives the next page.

tools.name: get_salon
tools.description: A salon's address, phone, weekly hours and full service menu (service_id, price, duration).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Open start times for one service with any technician, each as an ISO start_at and a local label. Searches from now when no date is given; up to 7 days.

service_id.description: The service's id on the salon's menu.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the salon's local time.

days.description: How many days from date. Default 1.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Books an appointment. Real and immediate: the salon holds the time and the customer gets a confirmation text. It can't be cancelled or changed online, only by calling the salon. Repeating the same call returns the same booking, never a second one.

service_id.description: The service's id on the salon's menu.

start_at.description: ISO start time of an open slot for this salon and service.

customer_name.description: The customer's name, as the salon should greet them.

customer_phone.description: The customer's mobile number; the confirmation text goes here.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the booking, e.g. "Claude". The salon sees "Booked by <agent_name>".
